method: All vertices with >35% dominant hand/arm/torso/head/neck weights, every 30 fps base action frame and 240 fps firing/pump frame. Inside requires negative nearest normal and >=12 of 14 deduplicated ray-parity votes. Reports penetrations deeper than 0.5 mm.
limits: Vertex samples can miss triangle-interior crossings; not continuous triangle-triangle collision proof.
Gun meshes have open/nonmanifold/overlapping surfaces. Parity agreement is diagnostic, not a guaranteed solid-volume classification.
No finger self-collision or clothing-body self-collision proof.
